content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XLIII.—स्वादिष्ट is a superlative, its construction with the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "ablatives is to be noted. रसवत् may be taken with अक्षर as an in-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 3, "text": "dependent epithet. The commentary in M. is as follows : यास-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 4, "text": "(sic should it be omitted ?) दैवी वाक् अमृतात्मनः कवीश्वरस्य अक्षरं ब्रह्म", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "वति (sic प्रस्त्रवति ?) प्रसूते तेनैवाक्षरेण वयं तृप्ताः संतुष्टाः किं लक्षणमक्षरं मधुनोपि स्वादिष्टं", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "किंवत् घृतादिरसवत् यथा घृतादिरसः आदिशब्दात् क्षीरखण्डाद्यतानीव किममृतात्मनः कवी-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 8, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "श्वरस्य अक्षरं मधुनोपि स्वादिष्टं रसवतः तव रसमयस्य. This is very obscure.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "The translation I propose is this : “ We are pleased with simply", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "those sweet utterances more delicious than honey or clarified but-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 12, "text": "ter which the divine and immortal Speech sends forth from her", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "sweet body”; or perhaps अमृतात्मनः might be taken as one", "end": "space"}, {"n": 14, "text": "and then it will be “from her sweet ambrosial body .” भृति", "end": "space"}, {"n": 15, "text": "may be either pleasure as in Kirâta VIII., 3 or support, susten-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 16, "text": "tation as in भिये एषा भिये (Uttararâmacharita).—S'ârdûlavikrîḍita.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": true, "note": "In line 3-4 यास- / वति (line 6) and line 7 क्षीरखण्डाद्यतानीव the Devanagari characters are somewhat worn/unclear."}, {"id": "r1", "type": "running_header", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "NOTES.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r2", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "69", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": "Notes", "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["u2"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "43", "label": "St. XLIII.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
